# braintrust_function (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust function: a prompt, scorer, preprocessor, tool, or other callable stored in a project. `function_data_json` describes the implementation (for example inline code), and `prompt_data_json` holds the prompt and model options for LLM-backed functions. See the examples below for each shape.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "braintrust_project" "example" {
  name = "functions-example"
}

resource "braintrust_function" "prompt" {
  project_id = braintrust_project.example.id
  name       = "Summarizer"
  slug       = "summarizer"

  function_data_json = jsonencode({ type = "prompt" })
  prompt_data_json = jsonencode({
    prompt  = { type = "completion", content = "Summarize {{input}}" }
    options = { model = "gpt-4o-mini" }
  })
}

resource "braintrust_function" "scorer" {
  project_id    = braintrust_project.example.id
  name          = "Pass scorer"
  slug          = "pass-scorer"
  function_type = "scorer"

  # Code scorers define a function named handler. QuickJS is only supported
  # for preprocessors; use node or python for scorers.
  function_data_json = jsonencode({
    type = "code"
    data = {
      type            = "inline"
      runtime_context = { runtime = "node", version = "20" }
      code            = "function handler({ output }) { return output ? 1 : 0; }"
    }
  })
}

resource "braintrust_function" "preprocessor" {
  project_id    = braintrust_project.example.id
  name          = "Input text"
  slug          = "input-text"
  function_type = "preprocessor"

  function_data_json = jsonencode({
    type = "code"
    data = {
      type            = "inline"
      runtime_context = { runtime = "quickjs", version = "ES2023" }
      code            = "function handler(spanData) { return { text: String(spanData.input || '') }; }"
    }
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `function_data_json` (String) JSON object describing the implementation. For inline code, use type=code with data.type=inline, runtime_context, and code. Global functions use type=global with a name and optional config.
- `name` (String) Display name of the function.
- `project_id` (String) Unique identifier for the project that the function belongs to.
- `slug` (String) Unique identifier for the function within the project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Textual description of the function.
- `function_schema_json` (String) Optional JSON schema for function parameters and return value. Changes replace the function because PATCH does not accept this field.
- `function_type` (String) Function type, for example scorer, preprocessor, tool, task, or llm. Omit for a prompt function to let the API choose its prompt type.
- `prompt_data_json` (String) Optional JSON prompt configuration for LLM-backed functions.
- `tags` (List of String) Function tags.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of function creation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the function (UUID).
- `metadata_json` (String) Metadata object returned by the API as JSON.
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier for the organization.
- `xact_id` (String) Transaction ID of the function version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the function ID.
terraform import braintrust_function.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
